handshake_pairs.name: ROW_CMD
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller drives ACT/PRE/REF/RFM/MRS on the R bus; DRAM decodes one row command per cycle per channel.

handshake_pairs.name: COL_CMD
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller drives RD/WR on the C bus; DRAM decodes per 32-bit pseudo-channel.

handshake_pairs.name: READ_BURST
handshake_pairs.rule: DRAM drives the burst on DQ at RL from READ, framed by RDQS.

handshake_pairs.name: WRITE_BURST
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller drives the burst on DQ at WL from WRITE, framed by WDQS.

handshake_pairs.name: RAS_ALERT
handshake_pairs.rule: DRAM raises AERR/DERR on CA-parity / ECC-uncorrectable errors.

handshake_pairs.name: REFRESH_MGMT
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller issues REF / RFM per channel to maintain retention and bound disturbance.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Within a channel, commands are committed on the rising edges of CK_t/CK_c. Row commands flow on the R bus, column commands on the C bus (decoded per pseudo-channel); the two buses can be active in the same cycle. Across channels there is no dependency — the 16 channels are completely independent and not necessarily synchronous.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Read data on a channel's DQ depends on its prior READ at read latency RL, framed by RDQS. Write data acceptance depends on the prior WRITE at write latency WL, framed by WDQS. No per-beat handshake.

power_pins.name: VDDQL
power_pins.purpose: Low-swing IO supply for high-speed links.

ordering_rules.command_register_edge: Rising edges of CK_t/CK_c, per channel.
ordering_rules.data_byte_order_within_burst: Per the JESD238 column-access / burst-order tables.
ordering_rules.channel_scheduling: Channels are scheduled independently; no cross-channel ordering guarantee.
ordering_rules.pseudo_channel_scheduling: The two pseudo-channels of a channel run independent column streams.

signals.name: WCK_t / WCK_c
signals.desc: Differential Write Clock at 2x CK data rate (per byte group), WCK2CK-aligned

signals.name: CA[9:0]
signals.desc: DDR command/address bus captured on CK

signals.name: DQ[15:0]
signals.desc: 16-bit data bus per channel, DDR on WCK

signals.name: DBI_n[1:0]
signals.desc: Data Bus Inversion, one per byte lane (active low)

signals.name: EDC[1:0]
signals.desc: Error-Detection pins (per byte lane): read/write CRC + EDC hold pattern
